_doc: applies_to lists the products a measure covers. Each entry is a ProductTypeProto name (e.g. TIPS, TREASURY_FRN) or a node name from ../hierarchy.json (e.g. BOND, STOCK, CASH_INSTRUMENT), which covers every product type under it. computed_by says where a measure's value comes from: input (supplied by the caller, not computed), ledger-service or valuation-service. The UNKNOWN_MEASURE sentinel has computed_by null. depends_on lists what a measure is computed from: other measure names from this catalog, plus these inputs: TAX_LOTS (the position's tax lots), SECURITY_TERMS (the security's terms and conditions), CPI_U (the CPI-U index series), BILL_FIXINGS (T-bill auction fixings), YIELD_CURVE (the discount curve) and TREASURY_PRICES (Treasury market prices). It is empty for an input.

measures.name: UNKNOWN_MEASURE
measures.description: Placeholder for unset or unrecognized measure values. Should never be requested in a valuation call.

measures.name: DIRECTED_QUANTITY
measures.description: The signed quantity of a position (e.g. number of shares, or total face value of bonds held). This is an input measure provided on the PositionProto, not a computed output.
measures.units: Units of the security (shares for equity, face-value dollars for bonds)

measures.name: MARKET_VALUE
measures.description: The current dollar value of a position at the given market price.
measures.formula: MarketValue = price / 100 * directed_quantity; TIPS: clean_price / 100 * index_ratio * directed_quantity (index_ratio unrounded, unfloored)
model_assumptions: None — direct mark-to-market calculation

measures.name: UNADJUSTED_COST_BASIS
measures.description: The original purchase price of the security, before any adjustments for amortization, accretion, or corporate actions.
measures.formula: Returns the price_input as-is (quoted as % of par for bonds)
measures.units: Quoted price (% of par for bonds; dollar price for equities)
model_assumptions: None — pass-through of the input price

measures.name: ADJUSTED_COST_BASIS
measures.description: Tax amortised cost, per 100 face, quantity-weighted over the open lots. Tax basis only; book (GAAP/IFRS) cost is out of scope. Inputs: cost_basis (CostBasisInput) on BondInput, TipsInput or FrnInput.
measures.formula: AdjustedCostBasis = sum(open_quantity_i * acb_i) / sum(open_quantity_i) over CostBasisInput.lots, where acb_i is lot i's amortised cost per 100 face at the valuation date. OID: always accreted (mandatory, whatever the elections) at constant yield from the issue price (IssuanceProto.price_for_single_price_auction, MDI-82), reduced by any acquisition premium. Premium (IRC §171): amortised at constant yield if elected. Market discount: accreted only with INCLUDE_CURRENTLY, ratably or at constant yield per market_discount_accrual; otherwise left until disposition. De minimis: OID and market discount below 0.25% × complete years to maturity are treated as zero. TIPS: AdjustedCostBasis = sum(open_quantity_i * real_acb_i) / sum(open_quantity_i) * IndexRatio(valuation date), where real_acb_i is lot i's amortised cost per 100 real face: it starts from the lot's real purchase price (TaxLotProto.price) and accrues at constant yield on real principal; open_quantity_i is the lot's original (unadjusted) face; and IndexRatio(valuation date) is INDEX_RATIO for the UTC date of ValuationRequestProto.asof_datetime. Example: lots of 10000 at real_acb 99.00 and 5000 at 101.50, index ratio 1.2 -> (10000*99.00 + 5000*101.50) / 15000 * 1.2 = 119.80.
measures.units: Price per 100 face (% of par). TIPS: per 100 original face, in nominal dollars
model_assumptions: Accrual start: from each lot's open_date plus the product's settlement lag (e.g. T+1 for Treasuries)
Elections: CostBasisInput.elections, copied from PortfolioProto.amortisation_elections; unset fields use the defaults (PREMIUM_ELECTED, AT_DISPOSITION, RATABLE)
TIPS: amortise in real terms, then multiply by the index ratio at the valuation date, giving a figure per 100 original face in nominal dollars
TIPS accrual start: from each lot's open_date plus the product's settlement lag, on real principal; valuation-service owns the settlement lag and lots carry no settlement field
TIPS elections: premium and market discount accrue or not per the elections, as in the fixed-rate rules
TIPS CPI: only the m-3 and m-2 readings for the valuation date in TipsInput.cpi; lot dates need no CPI readings
TIPS rounding: none. real_acb_i, the weighted average, the index ratio and the result are all unrounded, as for INDEX_RATIO and MARKET_VALUE
TIPS deflation floor: not applied. It applies only to final principal (INFLATION_ADJUSTED_PRINCIPAL), never to the basis
FRN: use the equivalent fixed rate from the fixing at settlement
Treasury FRN (frn_extension.reference_rate_index T_BILL_13_WEEK, LM-383): inputs are FrnInput.cost_basis (lots and elections) and FrnInput.fixings
Treasury FRN per lot: amortise each lot as the equivalent fixed-rate instrument, using the same constant-yield, elections and de minimis rules as the fixed-rate bonds

Treasury FRN coupon: the lot's equivalent fixed coupon, as a decimal fraction, is coupon_i = MMY(fixing_i) + spread / 10000. fixing_i is the fixing in effect at the lot's accrual start, i.e. the FrnInput.fixings entry with the latest fixing_date on or before it; spread is frn_extension.spread, in basis points
Treasury FRN OID: the fixing in effect on bond_details.issue_date (the latest fixing_date on or before it) sets the issue-date OID schedule
Treasury FRN resets: later coupon resets do not change a lot's schedule

Treasury FRN conversion: fixings.rate is the published high discount rate in percent (see ReferenceRateFixingProto.rate). valuation-service converts it to the money-market yield, on a 360-day basis: MMY = 360 * d / (360 - d * t), where d = rate / 100 and t = bill_maturity_date - bill_issue_date, in days, both from the same fixing. bill_issue_date is the chosen auction's own issue date, so a reopened bill counts from the reopening. Example: rate 4.215, t 91 -> d = 0.04215, MMY = 360 * 0.04215 / (360 - 0.04215 * 91) = 0.042604 (rounded here only)
Treasury FRN missing data: no fixing on or before a needed date (a lot's accrual start, or the issue date) makes the request invalid
Treasury FRN other indices (e.g. SOFR): not defined yet
No lots: the measure is absent, with a "no open lots" warning, never 0

measures.name: CURRENT_YIELD
measures.description: Annual coupon income as a percentage of the current market price.
measures.formula: CurrentYield = (coupon_rate * principal) / (price * face_value / 100). For zero-coupon: (face_value / dollar_price)^(1 / years_to_maturity) - 1
model_assumptions: Assumes coupon income is constant (no reinvestment assumption)
For TIPS, uses the inflation-adjusted principal for the annual coupon calculation
Day count: Actual/365 for years-to-maturity calculation

measures.name: YIELD_TO_MATURITY
measures.description: The annualized rate of return assuming the bond is held to maturity and all coupons are reinvested at the same rate. This is the internal rate of return that equates the present value of all future cashflows to the current price.
measures.formula: Solve for r: price * (face / 100) = Sum[C / (1 + r/m)^t] + F / (1 + r/m)^N
model_assumptions: Coupon reinvestment at the YTM rate (standard bond math assumption)
For TIPS: returns the same value as REAL_YIELD, with the response summary warning "YIELD_TO_MATURITY for TIPS is the real yield (same as REAL_YIELD); a nominal yield needs an inflation forecast"
Settlement on a coupon date (no accrued interest adjustment currently)
Day count: Actual/365 for years-to-maturity
Solver: Newton-Raphson iteration with linear approximation initial guess

measures.name: MACAULAY_DURATION
measures.description: The weighted average time (in years) to receive all cashflows from a bond, where each cashflow's weight is its proportion of the bond's total present value.
measures.formula: D = Sum[(t / m) * PV_t / TotalPV]
model_assumptions: Uses the bond's YTM (from Newton-Raphson solver) as the discount rate
Flat yield curve (single rate for all maturities)
Settlement on a coupon date (integer period exponents)

measures.name: PRESENT_VALUE
measures.description: The theoretical price of a bond computed as the sum of all future cashflows (coupons + principal) discounted at the bond's yield to maturity.
measures.formula: PV = Sum[C / (1 + r/m)^t] + F / (1 + r/m)^N, returned as quoted price (% of par)
measures.units: Quoted price (% of par; e.g. 95.00 = $95 per $100 face)
model_assumptions: Same as YIELD_TO_MATURITY (the discount rate is derived from the input price)
For TIPS: inflation-adjusted cash flows discounted at REAL_YIELD, consistent with clean_price × index_ratio
Three-way invariant: price == present_value == sum(cashflow_pvs)

measures.name: REAL_YIELD
measures.description: The yield of a TIPS bond in real (inflation-adjusted) terms. This is the return an investor earns above the rate of inflation.
measures.formula: Solve for r: clean_price × index_ratio × face / 100 = Sum[PV(inflation-adjusted cash flows at r)]
measures.units: Decimal (0-1 scale; e.g. 0.02 = 2.00% real annual yield)
model_assumptions: Same solver and conventions as YIELD_TO_MATURITY
The quoted real price is scaled by the same index ratio as the cash flows, so the result is the true real yield and does not change with CPI

measures.name: INFLATION_ADJUSTED_PRINCIPAL
measures.description: The inflation-adjusted principal of a TIPS bond, reflecting the cumulative change in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) since the bond's issuance.
measures.formula: adjusted_principal = max(face_value * index_ratio, face_value)
measures.units: Dollars (e.g. 103.36 for face=100 with 3.36% cumulative inflation)
model_assumptions: Uses base_cpi from the security's tips_extension and the reference CPI from TipsInput.cpi
Deflation floor applies only to the principal at maturity; interim coupons use the raw adjusted principal

measures.name: PRESENT_VALUE_CASHFLOWS
measures.description: Requests the full schedule of future cashflows for a bond. The ValuationResponseProto will populate the cashflows repeated field with one CashflowProto per payment period.
measures.formula: Each CashflowProto contains: cashflow_date, fv_amount, pv_amount, coupon_rate. Sum of pv_amounts equals PRESENT_VALUE.
measures.units: fv_amount and pv_amount in dollars; coupon_rate as percentage
model_assumptions: Same as PRESENT_VALUE
Three-way invariant: sum(pv_amounts) == present_value == price

measures.name: DISCOUNT_MARGIN
measures.description: The discount margin of a Floating Rate Note (FRN) — the spread over the reference rate at which the market discounts the FRN's projected cashflows to arrive at its current price. This is the FRN analogue of YTM.
measures.formula: Solve for DM: price = Sum[(R + QM)/m * FV / (1 + (R + DM)/m)^t] + FV / (1 + (R + DM)/m)^N
model_assumptions: Flat forward rates: all future reference rate fixings assumed equal to current observation
When DM = QM, price = par (100) on a reset date
When DM > QM, price < par; when DM < QM, price > par
Solver: Newton-Raphson, same as YTM

T_BILL_13_WEEK fixings: FrnInput.fixings rate is the auction's high discount rate as Treasury publishes it, in percent per annum on a bank-discount basis (4.215 = 4.215%), the same as IssuanceProto.high_discount_rate. valuation-service converts it to the money-market yield the FRN accrues on, using the fixing's bill_maturity_date. SOFR fixings stay decimal fractions (0.0432 = 4.32%).

measures.name: SPREAD_DURATION
measures.description: The sensitivity of an FRN's price to a 1 basis point change in the discount margin. This is the primary risk measure for FRNs, analogous to modified duration for fixed-rate bonds but measuring spread risk rather than rate risk.
measures.formula: SpreadDuration = (P_down - P_up) / (2 * 0.0001 * P_base)
measures.units: Years (e.g. 1.90 = a 1bp spread widening causes ~1.90bp price decline)
model_assumptions: Same flat-forward assumption as DISCOUNT_MARGIN
Uses a symmetric 1bp bump for numerical differentiation
Interest rate duration of an FRN is near-zero; spread duration captures the economically significant risk

measures.name: PAR_YIELD
measures.description: The par yield at a given maturity point on the yield curve. The par yield is the coupon rate at which a bond would trade at par (price = 100) for a given maturity.
measures.formula: Solve for c: 100 = Sum[c/m / (1 + r_t)^t] + 100 / (1 + r_N)^N
model_assumptions: Coupon frequency matches market convention (semiannual for US Treasuries)
Interpolation between observed maturities uses method specified in CurveRequestProto

measures.name: SPOT_YIELD
measures.description: The spot (zero-coupon) yield at a given maturity. Represents the pure time value of money with no reinvestment assumption.
measures.formula: Bootstrapped from par curve: s_N = ((100 + c/m) / (100 - Sum[c/m / (1+s_t)^t]))^(1/N) - 1
model_assumptions: Requires a complete par yield curve as input
Bootstrap assumes exact coupon dates

measures.name: FORWARD_YIELD
measures.description: The forward yield between two future dates, implied by the spot curve. The rate agreed today for borrowing/lending between future times t1 and t2.
measures.units: Decimal (0-1 scale; e.g. 0.048 = 4.80% annual forward rate)
model_assumptions: Derived from spot curve (bootstrapped from par)
No-arbitrage between spot and forward rates
Forward period defined by adjacent tenor points

measures.name: PROFIT_LOSS
measures.description: The profit or loss on a position relative to its cost basis.
measures.formula: ProfitLoss = MarketValue - (UnadjustedCostBasis / d * DirectedQuantity), where d = 100 for par-quoted securities (bonds, TIPS, FRNs) and d = 1 for dollar-quoted securities (equities, cash)
model_assumptions: The measure is absent, never 0, when MarketValue, UnadjustedCostBasis or DirectedQuantity is unavailable

measures.name: PROFIT_LOSS_PERCENT
measures.description: The profit or loss as a percentage of the original cost basis.
measures.formula: ProfitLossPercent = ProfitLoss / (UnadjustedCostBasis / d * DirectedQuantity), where d = 100 for par-quoted securities (bonds, TIPS, FRNs) and d = 1 for dollar-quoted securities (equities, cash)
model_assumptions: The measure is absent, never 0, when MarketValue, UnadjustedCostBasis or DirectedQuantity is unavailable

measures.name: ACCRUED_INTEREST
measures.description: The coupon interest accrued from the last coupon date up to (but not including) the settlement date, per the security's day count. Earned but not yet received.
measures.formula: Fixed-coupon bonds and TIPS: AccruedInterest = (coupon_rate / coupon_frequency) * (days_since_last_coupon / days_in_period) * directed_quantity. Treasury FRNs: AccruedInterest = Σ_{each day} (index_fixing_d + spread) / 360 * directed_quantity, where directed_quantity is the position's face
measures.units: Dollars (absolute dollar amount for the position)
model_assumptions: Day count: the security's (Actual/Actual (ICMA) for US Treasuries)
Treasury FRNs: the fixings are the ones supplied in the request; no curve is used
Returns null/zero for Equity, Cash, and zero-coupon bonds

measures.name: CONVEXITY
measures.description: The second derivative of a bond's price with respect to yield, normalised by price. Convexity measures how the duration of a bond changes as yield changes — a bond with higher convexity gains more in price when yields fall and loses less when yields rise, compared to a bond with lower convexity of equal duration.
model_assumptions: Same as MACAULAY_DURATION (flat yield curve, YTM-based discounting)
For TIPS: y = REAL_YIELD and CF_t are the inflation-adjusted cash flows
For FRN: uses flat-forwards effective YTM (same model as PRESENT_VALUE)
Settlement on a coupon date (integer period exponents)

measures.name: DIRTY_PRICE
measures.description: The full (invoice) price of a bond including accrued interest, expressed as a percentage of face value.
measures.formula: DirtyPrice = CLEAN_PRICE + accrued_interest_per_bond / face_value * 100, where CLEAN_PRICE is the supplied market clean price and accrued_interest_per_bond is ACCRUED_INTEREST for one bond of face_value, as of the settlement date. The result is a percentage of par, per bond, and is never scaled by quantity

measures.name: CLEAN_PRICE
measures.description: The market clean price per 100 of face (excluding accrued interest), as supplied in the request — e.g. the FedInvest end-of-day price via price-service. An input, never computed: valuation-service returns UNIMPLEMENTED for it.

measures.name: MODIFIED_DURATION
measures.description: Measures the percentage price change of a bond for a 1% (100bp) change in yield. Unlike Macaulay Duration (which is expressed in years), Modified Duration is a direct measure of price sensitivity: a bond with ModifiedDuration=5 will move approximately 5% in price for a 100bp parallel shift in yield.
measures.formula: ModifiedDuration = MacaulayDuration / (1 + ytm/n), where ytm = yield to maturity (annual), n = coupon periods per year. For TIPS, ytm = REAL_YIELD (on the inflation-adjusted cash flows)
measures.units: Years (dimensionally equivalent to years, interpreted as % per 100bp)

measures.name: DV01
measures.description: DV01 (Dollar Value of 01) = the dollar P&L impact of a 1bp (0.01%) yield increase.
measures.formula: DV01 = ModifiedDuration × MarketValue × 0.0001

measures.name: DISCOUNT_YIELD
measures.description: U.S. Treasury Bill discount-basis yield. The market convention used by TreasuryDirect auction results ("High discount rate"), Bloomberg TBILL screens, and most short-tenor money-market quotes.
measures.formula: DiscountYield = (F - P) / F × 360 / days_to_maturity, where F = face value (par), P = dollar price, day count is Actual/360
model_assumptions: Simple (non-compounded) discount basis — standard U.S. money-market
360-day year (Actual/360 day count)
Assumes the security has a defined maturity_date and face_value; null for instruments where days_to_maturity is undefined

measures.name: BOND_EQUIVALENT_YIELD
measures.description: Bond-Equivalent Yield (BEY) for U.S. Treasury Bills — also known as the "investment rate" published alongside DISCOUNT_YIELD on TreasuryDirect. The conventional way to compare TBill returns to coupon-bearing bond yields (which conventionally use a 365-day year).
measures.formula: BondEquivalentYield = (F - P) / P × 365 / days_to_maturity, where F = face value (par), P = dollar price, day count is Actual/365
model_assumptions: Simple (non-compounded) basis
365-day year (Actual/365 day count)
Same applicability constraints as DISCOUNT_YIELD

measures.name: REFERENCE_CPI
measures.description: The reference CPI of a TIPS for the settlement date (UTC date of ValuationRequestProto.asof_datetime), the numerator of the index ratio.
measures.formula: reference_cpi as given, or RefCPI = CPI(m-3) + (d - 1) / days_in_month * (CPI(m-2) - CPI(m-3)) from monthly readings
model_assumptions: Reference CPI from TipsInput.cpi
Unrounded (Treasury publishes 5 decimals)
Request rejected unless readings are exactly months m-3 and m-2 (UTC settlement month)
Absent when no CPI is given

measures.name: INDEX_RATIO
measures.description: The index ratio of a TIPS for the settlement date: reference CPI over the security's base CPI.
measures.formula: IndexRatio = reference_cpi / base_cpi (unrounded, unfloored)
model_assumptions: Reference CPI from TipsInput.cpi
Unrounded (Treasury publishes 5 decimals)
Unfloored: the deflation floor applies to INFLATION_ADJUSTED_PRINCIPAL only
